name: Kaya at Town Square
paymentPlan: 10% Down Payment at the sales launch / 40% During / 50% On Handover
overview: Kaya at Town Square by Nshama is a stunning new residential development redefining modern urban living in Dubai. Strategically located within the thriving Town Square community, this project offers contemporary 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments designed with exceptional attention to detail. Kaya blends style, function, and lifestyle convenience to create a complete residential experience that caters to professionals, couples, and families alike.
